name: Quinn
self_text: I’m a Nigerian designer in my mid‑30s who loves climbing and learning languages. I find language practice comes alive when I study independently side by side with a partner—sharing notes, explaining each other’s errors, and staying online together. Saturdays are my favorite, so I’m usually free on Saturday mornings for a relaxed, joint study session.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into working through problems together or a step‑by‑step walkthrough session, you must be available Saturday morning, and you must be the one who has things explained by me. A nice bonus would be if we overlap on online, though it’s not a requirement.
